description: Only the very first account in the system, the seeded super admin, can open the admin-only user management endpoints. Admins created later get 403 Forbidden even though their role is admin and their token is valid.
data_flow: JwtStrategy.validate puts the JWT payload (id, role, sessionId) on request.user; RolesGuard compares the required roles from @Roles(RoleEnum.admin) to request.user.role.id
Comparing against request.user.id instead of the role id only matches when the user id happens to equal the admin role id (1)
notes: RoleEnum.admin = 1 and the seeded admin has user id 1, hiding the bug for the first account only.
